mechanism_narrative: The consistent week-on-week decline in RETAIL_REC mobility over the last four weeks indicates a deepening trend of reduced discretionary spending and out-of-home activity, which will persist and drive further decreases over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, indicating a reversal of the observed trend.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained and deep decline in WORKPLACES mobility, falling below -50% for two consecutive weeks, signifies widespread adherence to work-from-home directives, which will continue to suppress weekday retail activity over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls below -50% for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, despite WORKPLACES remaining below -50% for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of persistently high RESIDENTIAL mobility and extremely low TRANSIT usage indicates a strong and reinforcing stay-at-home behavior, which will directly reduce the demand for retail and recreation activities over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the last 14 days, while RESIDENTIAL remains high and TRANSIT remains low.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive week-on-week increase in PARKS mobility, following a period of decline, suggests an early, cautious return of people to outdoor public spaces, which could translate into a slight positive spillover for nearby retail and recreation over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS shows week-on-week increase for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is lower than over the last 7 days, despite PARKS increasing for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The continuous and significant increase in RESIDENTIAL mobility, indicating more people are staying at home for longer periods, directly reduces the opportunity and need for out-of-home retail and recreation, leading to a further decline over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, despite RESIDENTIAL mobility continuing to increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GROCERY_PHARM mobility, falling below -10% for two consecutive weeks, signals a broader reduction in even essential out-of-home trips, which will further depress discretionary retail and recreation over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -10% for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the last 14 days, despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining below -10% for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous and deep declines in both WORKPLACES and PARKS mobility reflect a comprehensive lockdown environment, where both work-related and leisure-related outdoor activities are severely curtailed, ensuring continued suppression of retail and recreation over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, while both WORKPLACES and PARKS remain significantly below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Extremely low TRANSIT mobility, remaining below -60% for two consecutive weeks, indicates severe restrictions on public movement and a lack of confidence in public transport, which will directly limit access to and demand for retail and recreation over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -60% for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, despite TRANSIT remaining below -60% for two consecutive weeks.
